headline.title: Data Scientist - ML in Production, Segmentation & Forecasting
headline.summary: Impact driven data science across EA, Rockstar Games, Niantic, Amazon Games and MEC, from gradient-boosted bot detection in production and GTAO player segmentation to churn, LTV, store clustering and real-time pack-probability models. Open to remote contracts of 6 to 12 weeks

groups.label: Technical Contributor
bullets: Implemented behavioral and network-level features (session timing, click patterns, device fingerprinting, IP/request metadata) for gradient-boosted bot detection models across millions of daily traffic events

Deployed and iterated on XGBoost/LightGBM-based classification models in production, partnering closely with engineering teams to ship incremental improvements to detection accuracy while weighing false positive impact on legitimate users across the platform

Analyzed bot behavior patterns across large-scale traffic data to identify novel signal sources and edge cases, informing feature engineering work that improved model precision and reduced manual review burden
